# Starting Prompt:

I've copied some files in from the Dadabase repository.  This is a brand new repository and I would like help in updating the readme and also in creating a product requirements document so I can start work on this project.

Please update the readme with appropriate commentary.  This repo will be not as much an example as a working project, but I’d still like a light-hearted tone to the documentation.

I would like to create a project that would let me manage informal gatherings of friends, similar in function to a site like EventBrite, but much simpler.  The app would let friends of mine sign in with their credentials (like Facebook or Google creds) and authenticate.  To get signed up, they would need an invitation code from a person already in the system.

Once authenticated, they can join a circle of friends, and they would see different events or activities that they could participate in for that circle.  They could also create their own events and invite their friends to participate.  

Examples of events would be: 
- Pickleball this Wednesday at 6:00pm; 
- Pickleball League every week Saturday at 8:00am at the Hastings Park; 
- Watch SpiderMan movie – Friday at 7:00 at the Marcus Theatre; 
- Volunteer at Habitat for Humanity every Thursday; 
- Coffee at McDonalds every Friday at 7am;

I want this to be super simple to set up an event and invite your friends, and then a way to see who has responded and accepted or declined. An email would let you know when an event has been created, (and possibly a reminder if someone triggers it).

There should be a calendar for the application that lets you see upcoming events.

Look at these general guidelines and then ask me any clarifying questions using the grill me skill.  Once you have good information, then create a Product Requirements Document that spells out what should be done for me to review.

After the PRD has been approved, then we will move one to planning before implementation.
